name: GDS LP-mining reward paid on current LP balance
summary: GDS paid LP-mining rewards for every epoch since an account's lastEpoch in proportion to its LP balance at claim time. The attacker registered dozens of helper contracts holding dust LP, waited for the epoch to roll over, then passed flash-funded LP through each helper so every one claimed the full backlog, and sold the GDS into the pair.
notes: Anchor is the first claim of the reward backlog; the earlier attacker txs (0x73efde76, 0x364b13ae, 0xf9b6cc08, 0x92031df0) only bought GDS for helpers, burned it to activate them and parked dust LP, moving nothing out of the LP pool.

Direct immutable token; later owner calls (start, setFeeRate(5) reward size, setContract(3)) are trading gates or size the reward, not needed state. The admin's later migrate of the pool's GDS to dead is not an exploit.
Loss is the GDS/USDT pair's gross USDT depletion in the claim tx and the attacker's sale of the claimed GDS (rule 12); the attacker's setup purchases into the pair are not netted (rule 11).
